subject: Order form insurance: multi-entity COIs and retroactive date question
messages:
From: Sarah Jensen <sarah.jensen@novaplay.com>
To: david_kim@redwood.ai
Date: 2026-10-22T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Insurance evidence for Order Form - NovaPlay

Hi David,

Thanks again for the demo yesterday. Procurement ran the Order Form by our broker and we have two insurance items that need to be clarified before we can route for final approval:

1) Multi-entity COI: we need the Certificate of Insurance to name a list of NovaPlay entities and affiliates (NovaPlay Inc., NovaPlay Studios LLC, NovaPlay International Ltd.). Can Redwood issue a single COI covering those named entities as certificate holders and (preferably) as Additional Insureds?

2) Cyber retroactive date: our security team requires that the cyber policy either be occurrence-based or (if claims-made) have a retroactive date on or before 2019-01-01. Can you confirm Redwood's cyber placement and whether a retroactive date can be provided?

Other asks: 30-day cancellation notice, waiver of subrogation in favor of NovaPlay where permitted. I attached the latest Order Form for reference (NovaPlay_orderform_v3.pdf).

If you can share a temporary COI and a plan/timeline for endorsement delivery (or acceptable alternative wording), we can keep the onboarding timeline intact.

Thanks,
Sarah

Sarah — thanks for the clear note and the order form. We're excited to move this forward. Quick summary of Redwood's position and next steps: 

- Multi-entity COI: We can provide a single COI naming the NovaPlay entities you listed as certificate holders. For Additional Insured status we typically provide carrier endorsement on a limited basis; I can request an endorsement that names the three entities as Additional Insureds on a primary/non-contributory basis. If the carrier cannot endorse, we will propose a contractual indemnity to bridge the gap (per legal).

- Cyber retroactive date: Redwood currently places cyber coverage on a claims-made basis. We will ask our broker for a retroactive date back to 2019-01-01; I cannot promise the carrier will agree but will escalate. If the carrier refuses that retro date, legal has suggested an indemnity clause to address pre-policy acts.

- Cancellation notice: we can request 30-day notice language from our carrier.

Immediate ask from our side: please loop in your broker contact so we can coordinate endorsement language and timing. Also confirm whether NovaPlay will accept a temporary COI for onboarding (30–60 days) with the requirement that the final endorsement be delivered within 60 days of execution.

I've attached a temporary COI template we can issue quickly and will put the carrier request in motion. Action items: 
  * David — request endorsement & retro date from carrier (today)
  * Kimberly — review fallback indemnity language if retro date is not available
  * Karthik — confirm if sales can accept temporary COI for onboarding

I'll follow up after I hear back from our broker.

Best,
David Kim
Head of Partnerships, Redwood Inference

From: kimberly_park@redwood.ai

Date: 2026-10-22T11:30:00-07:00
Subject: RE: Insurance evidence for Order Form - NovaPlay

Team — copying in my quick guidance to use if carrier cannot provide the requested retro date or endorsement: 

1) Endorsement ask: we should request Additional Insured endorsement (CG 20 10 or equivalent) to the extent carriers will provide. If carrier will not provide primary/non-contributory language, we can accept Additional Insured on a contributory basis but should require the contractual indemnity described below.

2) Cyber retroactive gap: Because Redwood's cyber is claims-made, if we cannot obtain the 2019 retroactive date the two options are:
   - Obtain carrier endorsement extending the retroactive date to 2019-01-01 (preferred), or
   - Insert a narrow contractual indemnity in the MSA/Order Form covering acts prior to policy inception that gives NovaPlay indemnity for third-party claims tied to Redwood's services. Limit the indemnity to avoid open-ended exposure (e.g., cap tied to insurance limits or a defined period).

3) Notice and subrogation: 30-day cancellation notice is standard ask; waiver of subrogation acceptable where carrier permits.

If NovaPlay confirms they will accept a temp COI for 45–60 days with written confirmation that the endorsement will follow, we can approve onboarding. I'll draft the fallback indemnity clause now and send redline language by EOD.

-Kimberly
Kimberly Park 
General Counsel, Redwood Inference

David/Kim — thanks for the quick turnaround. Per our broker (Amy Cho) the carrier is open to issuing a COI naming the entities as certificate holders but is pushing back on Additional Insured endorsement for historical cyber exposures. Broker's suggested compromise: NovaPlay will accept a temporary COI for onboarding and a written broker acknowledgment committing to obtain the endorsement within 60 days, or alternatively a signed contractual indemnity as Kimberly outlined.

Broker contact: Amy Cho, BridgeBroke Insurance (amy.cho@bridgebroke.com). She said her team will attempt to secure a retroactive date of 2019-01-01 but flagged that some carriers will only provide that on a negotiated basis. I've attached a short broker acknowledgement they can sign (Broker_ack.txt).

We can accept a 60-day temporary COI provided we get either: (a) endorsement delivered within 60 days, or (b) a signed indemnity that covers pre-policy acts up to a cap. Please confirm Redwood's intention today so we can route to legal/ops on our side.

Thanks,
Sarah

Sarah/Amy — appreciate the broker note and the workable compromise. Redwood confirms the following path: 

1) We will issue a temporary COI naming NovaPlay Inc., NovaPlay Studios LLC, and NovaPlay International Ltd. as certificate holders and provide the Broker Acknowledgement countersigned by Redwood within 24 hours so you can proceed with onboarding.

2) Concurrently, I'll escalate to our carrier to request (A) Additional Insured endorsement naming the three entities with primary/non-contributory wording and (B) a cyber retroactive date of 2019-01-01. If the carrier can provide both, they will be delivered as endorsements within 60 days.

3) If the carrier cannot provide the retroactive date or the AI endorsement, Redwood Legal (Kimberly) will provide calibrated indemnity language to be appended to the Order Form to address pre-policy exposures. Kimberly, please proceed with the draft indemnity and share with NovaPlay legal for review.

4) Ops note: Karthik, please record that we accept a 60-day temporary COI as part of onboarding for DEAL-8372. Sales to note the carrier/endorsement risk in the deal record.

Related links: HubSpot deal (https://hubspot.com/deal/DEAL-8372) and DocuSign for the Order Form (https://app.redwood.com/docusign/abc123).

Planned dates: temp COI + countersigned broker ack — by 2026-10-23. Carrier response on endorsement/retro date — target by 2026-11-05. Final endorsement or indemnity to be in place by 2026-11-21.

Thanks all — I'll update this thread as soon as I hear from the broker/carrier.

-David
